correctness.rationale: In the three-dimensional triangular ODE, positivity/host logistic bound and parasite logistic lower comparison give liminf z≥k3; bk3>k2 then yields exponential y-decay, while upper logistic comparison gives z→k3. Commensal equation x′=F(x)+(r1a/k1)x y(t), with P(u)=r1(1−u/k1)(m1E+m2u)−qE and strict parameter inequalities yields F roots 0<u−<u+, the former repelling and 0,u+ attracting in limit. Bounded scalar solutions converge to one root via eventual fixed signs off isolated roots. For fixed y0,z0, ordered scalar flow and open basin sets, small-x extinction and comparison at x0≥u− persistence give a separator; difference of two purported separator solutions would satisfy d′/d→λ−>0 while both bounded, contradiction: separator is unique in (0,u−). Stable manifold around (u−,0,k3) controls small-host derivative: X′=λ−X+(r1au−/k1)Y(t), bounded X(0)=−(r1au−/k1)∫e^(−λ−t)Ydt. Strict scalar logistic order makes I(z0) strictly decreasing. Independently factored P(u)=−u²/2+7u/4−1 for example; roots (7±sqrt17)/4, λ−=0.3040290210515867, derivative −0.1378848902104175 reproduced exactly. Finite example does not substitute for proof.

originality.rationale: The original Puspitasari–Kusumawinahyu–Trisilowati 2021 model paper establishes equilibria and local stability, not a global ordered basin threshold for every (y0,z0). Liu–Yue 2022 full paper has global extinction Theorem3.1 under r1<qE/(m1E+m2k1), and global positive T5 Theorem3.2 under q<r1m1; both are incompatible with the present open bistability interval r1m1<q<q*, and neither proves a unique separator or parasite derivative. The new theorem uses a nonautonomous scalar/2D limiting host system to classify initial-data basins globally and quantitative sensitivity. Earlier equilibrium count is explicitly credited. Literature searches for aliases bistability/separatrix/harvest/commensal/parasite yielded no implication-dominating source. A 2022 Chen–Zhou–Lin WSEAS item on global stability remains a plausible secondary overlap needing cautious bounded comparison.

value.rationale: The paper fills a genuine gap between local equilibrium calculations and global fate for every positive initial state in an open bistable harvesting regime. A unique two-parameter stable-manifold basin graph and strict initial-parasite sensitivity are mathematically meaningful exact stability/threshold facts, not a minor correction to an already-known equilibrium table. It connects biological initial-conditions to an analytic quantitative rescue boundary, with clearly scoped fold and persistent-host exclusions.
